mechanism: Both drugs can cause hemolysis and nephrotoxicity; primaquine causes hemolysis in G6PD-deficient patients while vancomycin carries nephrotoxicity risk, potentially compounding renal dysfunction and hemolytic complications.
action: Monitor renal function, hemoglobin/hematocrit, and ensure G6PD status is known before primaquine use; use vancomycin doses cautiously with renal monitoring.
